listings.remarks: Desirable Palisades neighborhood. Built in 1974, this unique floor plan features a bright ground-floor living room with vaulted ceilings, large windows, french doors and a dramatic second-floor mezzanine living room that overlooks the space below. Wood burning fireplace, natural gas forced air heat, central AC, and wood floors throughout. With primary bedrooms on both the ground and second floor this 4 bedroom home offers exceptional versatility for multi-generational living, guests, or a private home office. Each floor offers a full hall bath. Enjoy the Japanese-inspired garden, a peaceful retreat for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying nature and privacy. Brand new roof, fresh paint throughout, $50,000 cedar fencing and automatic gate. Lots of parking and turnaround space all behind a private gated driveway. Lake and swim easement eligible for Palisades Park. Convenient access to parks, schools, shopping and I-5. No HOA. Seller is related to broker.

Don’t miss the opportunity to make this exceptional Lake Oswego home your own! Lovingly maintained by the original owners, this spacious home was thoughtfully remodeled and expanded in 2013–2014 and offers an incredible combination of comfort, functionality, and indoor/outdoor living. Recent updates include a newer roof, 2021 furnace, and quartz countertops in the hall bath.A dramatic vaulted entry welcomes you into the home, featuring a dedicated office, formal living and dining rooms, and an updated kitchen with designer granite countertops, large center island with eating bar, copper sink, stainless steel appliances, pantry, and abundant cabinetry. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the spacious great room with custom built-ins and a cozy gas fireplace.Step outside to your private backyard retreat, perfect for year-round entertaining! Enjoy the expansive covered patio, two gazebos—including one with a BBQ gas line and another housing a premium spa—plus raised garden beds, blueberry bushes, fruit trees, beautiful landscaping, and a powered storage shed.The main level also offers a laundry room with utility sink and a flexible office or optional bedroom. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features dual vanities, jetted soaking tub, tiled shower, and two walk-in closets. Three additional bedrooms, an oversized flex space, and bonus/media room provide plenty of room for work, play, guests, or hobbies.An oversized 3-car garage includes generator-ready wiring and a Honda 6500 generator. Located in the highly desirable Lake Oswego School District and near parks, shopping, dining, and more!

Completely reimagined and extensively renovated, this stunning mid-century home blends modern design with effortless Lake Oswego living. Tucked in one of the area’s most coveted neighborhoods, the home offers peek-a-boo lake views and access to multiple private lake easements, including Blue Heron, Alder Point, Maple Circle, and LG Swim Park on Oswego Lake.Thoughtfully redesigned for today’s lifestyle, the home features an open-concept layout filled with natural light, expansive picture windows, and beautifully curated finishes throughout. The fully remodeled kitchen showcases an open layout, quartz countertops, new appliances, and a walk-in pantry—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.A luxurious primary suite addition offers a true retreat, complete with a spa-inspired bathroom, walk-in closet, and enhanced functionality. Multiple living spaces, including a spacious lower-level family room, provide flexibility for relaxation, work, or hosting guests.Extensive upgrades include a new roof, electrical, plumbing, sewer line, tile flooring, and more—delivering peace of mind and turnkey convenience.Set on a beautifully refreshed lot with new landscaping and outdoor space to enjoy year-round, this home is just minutes from downtown Lake Oswego, top-rated schools, parks, dining, and boutique shopping.The perfect opportunity to enjoy fully renovated living with coveted lake access—this is Southshore at its finest.

Offered for the first time, this thoughtfully reimagined Northwest contemporary blends the architectural character of the 1960s with the modern updates. Once inside, the home offers exceptional privacy and a peaceful setting just minutes from downtown Lake Oswego. Designed for true main-level living, the floor plan features a spacious primary suite, beautifully renovated living spaces, laundry room, and a generous flex room that’s easily large enough to serve as a fourth bedroom, home office, or guest room. Vaulted wood ceilings, exposed beams, expansive windows, and sliding doors fill the home with natural light while creating a seamless connection to the surrounding landscape. The heart of the home is the completely redesigned kitchen, featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a large island, new appliances, and abundant storage. An adjoining wet bar adds both style and function. The open layout flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas before extending to expansive decks overlooking the surrounding trees and seasonal mountain views offering impressive space for outdoor living. The renovation extends well beyond the finishes with updated plumbing and electrical, a new roof, newer HVAC system, new lighting, wide-plank flooring, remodeled bathrooms, and carefully selected materials that complement the home’s original architecture while providing the confidence of updated systems. The daylight lower level offers flexibility with two oversized bedrooms, one with an adjoining sitting area, a beautifully remodeled full bath, a spacious family room with a fireplace, and direct access to a covered deck and the backyard. Whether used for guests, multigenerational living, or additional gathering space, the layout adapts to a variety of lifestyles. Thoughtfully designed landscaping, stone pathways, a custom water feature, and multiple outdoor living spaces create a peaceful setting while remaining just minutes from everything Lake Oswego has to offer.

Move-in ready with brand-new carpet and refreshed interior paint throughout, this spacious Lake Oswego home offers exceptional value for its size, condition, location, and resort-style amenities. Tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac near Westlake Park, this light-filled home combines a flexible floor plan, abundant living space, and an incredible backyard with a plunge pool/spa (spool), outdoor kitchen, and turf putting green.South-facing exposure brings in natural light year-round, while soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and multiple living spaces provide flexibility for entertaining, working from home, hosting guests, or simply relaxing. Fresh interior updates make it easy to move right in, while the home provides a great canvas to add your own style over time.Outside, enjoy a private, resort-inspired backyard designed for year-round living and entertaining. Take a morning swim, host summer gatherings around the outdoor kitchen, practice your short game on the putting green, or create an additional wellness retreat with a sauna or peaceful garden space.One of the home’s greatest advantages is its Lake Oswego location and walkability. Enjoy convenient access to Mercato Grove, Kruse Village, restaurants, coffee shops, and Lake Grove Elementary, and lake privileges at Lake Grove Swim Park . With a move-in ready interior, rare outdoor amenities, generous square footage, and a highly connected Lake Oswego location, this home offers a compelling combination of space, lifestyle, condition, and value.

listings.address: 17965 LAKE HAVEN DR Lake Oswego, OR 97035
listings.remarks: Welcome to 17965 Lake Haven, a charming English Cottage Tudor-style home nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in a highly sought-after neighborhood. This thoughtfully designed home offers dual primary suites, including one on the main level, perfect for multigenerational living, guests, or use as a private caregiver suite. Both suites feature their own full bathrooms, providing comfort and flexibility. The property also includes a separate outbuilding with a dedicated gym and private office, creating the ideal space for working from home, fitness, hobbies, or creative pursuits. Enjoy the privacy of a fully fenced backyard and the opportunity to join two nearby lake easements, offering access to the area's beautiful waterfront amenities. Located within an area known for excellent schools, this exceptional home combines timeless character, versatile living spaces, and an unbeatable location.

Welcome to this beautifully updated three-level home offering exceptional space, comfort, and natural beauty. Freshly painted on the exterior and filled with abundant natural light, this spacious residence showcases refurbished hardwood floors, new carpeting, and thoughtfully designed living spaces throughout. The remodeled gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring state-of-the-art appliances including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, six-burner Viking gas cooktop, Dacor double ovens, and a Miele dishwasher. Multiple gathering spaces, highlighted by two gas fireplaces, create a warm and inviting atmosphere for everyday living and entertaining. The home offers four bedrooms and three-and-a-half bathrooms, including two recently updated baths. The luxurious primary suite features a bright, light-filled bathroom with a large soaking tub and a large walk-in closet. A dedicated home office with custom built-in shelving and cabinetry provides the perfect space for remote work or study. Upstairs, an oversized bonus room with its own private entrance, full bathroom, and exterior deck offers endless possibilities as a guest suite, media room, home business, or multi-generational living space. The lower level includes a wine cellar and a large flexible area ideal for a home theater, fitness studio, recreation room, or additional living space. A door opens directly to the backyard, where you'll discover a certified natural habitat featuring a tranquil stream and small pond water feature, creating a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Conveniently located near highly regarded schools, with the middle school approximately 1.5 miles away and the high school just 2.5 miles away. Enjoy easy access to downtown Lake Oswego, known for its charming shops, excellent restaurants, and popular farmers market. This exceptional property combines modern updates, flexible living spaces, and a serene natural setting in one of the area's most desirable communities.

Beautifully updated and thoughtfully maintained, this inviting single-level home is tucked away on a quiet dead-end street and set on an expansive 10,019 square foot lot framed by beautiful mature trees. Offering comfort, privacy, substantial recent improvements, and future potential, this home is ready to enjoy today while presenting exciting possibilities for tomorrow. The current owners have made significant investments, including a brand new roof, vinyl double pane windows throughout, and a brand new backyard deck. Inside, the light filled floor plan features three bedrooms, one and a half baths, updated flooring and trim, and a remodeled kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. A welcoming living room with wood burning fireplace provides a comfortable gathering space, while the generous, nearly fully fenced backyard offers room to enjoy, relax, entertain and garden. The new deck creates an inviting outdoor living area beneath the mature trees. Additional highlights include an attached two car garage, RV parking, and convenient single level living. The generous lot and zoning offers a potential redevelopment opportunity. Buyers to independently verify development potential, permitted uses, density, lot configuration, and feasibility with the City of Portland and applicable authorities. Conveniently located near Multnomah Village, downtown Portland, parks, transit, and major commuter routes, this is a rare opportunity to own a well cared for home with substantial recent improvements, generous lot with beautiful mature trees, exceptional outdoor space, and genuine future potential.

Fabulous open floor plan in light-filled home with a great yard. All 4 bedrooms upstairs, including primary ensuite with vaulted ceilings and walk-in closet. Spacious living and dining room with vaulted ceilings and wood burning fireplace. Kitchen opens to family room with easy deck access to spacious level fenced yard. All new interior paint. Convenient location with nearby bus line on Taylors Ferry Rd and easy access to multiple travel corridors. Numerous parks and SW Community Center nearby. Just minutes to Multnomah Village with shops, cafés, restaurants, and farmers market.

Easy living in this beautiful one-level home in sought-after Bridlemile. Like-new, completely updated home with fresh paint, designer finishes and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Relax! There’s no work to be done. Over $60,000 in upgrades since 2022. Open-concept living, dining and kitchen open to a private garden, with an easy flow for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. Kitchen features all new stainless-steel appliances and quartz countertops, plus an island with an eating bar. Three quiet bedrooms include custom closet systems. Updated bathroom has oversized stone shower, lighted mirror and large vanity. Enjoy roses, jasmine, lush green lawns and so much more in your tranquil gardens on almost a third of an acre, including raised beds for your flowers and vegetables. Secluded, peaceful neighborhood, but only five miles to downtown and just three blocks to Bridlemile School and Hamilton Park!

Located in the desirable Montclair neighborhood of Raleigh Hills and within the Raleigh Hills Water District, this beautifully remodeled bungalow offers exceptional parking, a detached two-car garage, and a tankless water heater. Inside, hardwood floors extend through the kitchen, dining room, family room, and hallway.The fully updated kitchen features new cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an island with an eating bar. The kitchen, dining, and family rooms connect seamlessly, with a deck just off the dining area and a gas fireplace anchoring the family room.The primary suite has been thoughtfully remodeled with a no-step shower, new cabinetry, updated counters, and modern fixtures. The hall bath includes a tub/shower combination, updated vanity, and a quartz countertop. Both bathrooms feature heated floors.Outside, the expansive deck and usable yard offer plenty of space for entertaining. The detached garage includes built-in rooms and currently accommodates one car.

3840 SW Patton Rd. | Southwest Portland Opportunity with Character, Cash Flow and Plenty of Deck Space-Tucked into the coveted Southwest hills, this 1921 home blends old Portland charm with real upside. To clarify, this is 2 separate living units. No interior stairwell. Originally a classic 2 bedroom, 1 bath main-level home, the property later added a separate lower-level living space with its own exterior access, creating a flexible setup that works well for owner-occupants, investors and multi-generational living.The main level offers approximately 1,150 square feet of living space, along with massive decks stretching across the entire backside of the home, about 600 square feet of outdoor living space perfect for morning coffee, evening wine, entertaining or just taking in the setting. The home’s NW cabin vibe and early-1900s farmhouse roots give it warmth, personality and a lot of possibilities.The lower level unit is approximately 950 square feet and is currently rented, providing a nice income stream that helps offset ownership costs. The current owner has also rented out the main level in the past, so the entire home has functioned as two separate rental units. That creates flexibility whether you are looking for a home with income potential, a setup for extended family, or an investment property with strong versatility.Priced well below much of what the Southwest hills has to offer, this is the kind of property that rewards vision. Set nicely amongst the tree's in a wonderfully natural setting within the city... just bring your inner English gardener goals and this home will fulfill your needs! Come & get it.

New price creates a great opportunity on this close-in West Hills home on spacious lot in highly coveted Sylvan Highlands Neighborhood! Here's your chance for the wonderful Ainsworth/West Sylvan/Lincoln High school district! This beautiful, solid mid-century home, on over-sized private lot is craving some love! Let your personal cosmetic finishes make it shine and create instant equity! Fresh paint inside and out, landscaping, and some cosmetics will go a long way! This home received a complete top to bottom remodel just 10 years including a new 50 yr roof, Furnace, Kitchen, Baths and more! The huge fenced "double" back yard has endless opportunities such as Sport Court, detached ADU, elite garden, etc... Sylvan Highlands neighbors The Oregon Zoo & Max Station, and is home to historic tennis center The Racquet Club. Just a few minutes to Downtown, Northwest Portland and Pearl District Restaurants, shopping and entertainment. Instant freeway access for short commutes to Nike, Intel and Hi-Tech Corridor! Washington Park and Forest Park are also nearby. Ready for you finishing touches to make it shine and and enjoy for many years to come!

Outstanding $25K Price Improvement!! *OPEN SUN, 9/13 from 2-4PM!* Perched in a prime Hillsdale location on a peaceful dead end street, this contemporary retreat captures sweeping Willamette River views and a delightful glimpse of Mt. Hood. Surrounded by mature trees, the home is designed to bring the outdoors in, with an open-concept main level featuring vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, and rich bamboo flooring that fills the space with natural light. At the heart of the home, the updated chef’s kitchen with an expansive island flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas creating an inviting space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level also offers a comfortable primary suite with a walk-in shower, dual vanities, and a spacious walk-in closet, along with a second bedroom and full bath. Downstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a versatile family or flex space, along with access to an oversized covered deck ideal for year round enjoyment.Recent updates include new interior and exterior paint, roof, HVAC system, lighting and carpet, providing both fresh updates and peace of mind. Ideally located just minutes from OHSU, downtown Portland, Hillsdale, and the scenic Terwilliger walking path and Markham trails, this home offers a rare blend of serene natural beauty and urban convenience.

This is the kind of home that just feels good the moment you walk in. Beautifully updated, warm, and completely move in ready, every space feels intentional. The kitchen has been transformed with quartz countertops, professionally repainted cabinetry, and modern finishes, while updated bathrooms and new high end carpet give the home a fresh, polished feel throughout. But the backyard may steal the show. Cedar decking, landscape lighting, and a dedicated entertaining space create the perfect setting for summer dinners, morning coffee, or evenings with friends. And with a newer roof, furnace and A/C, fresh exterior paint, and a new garage door and opener, the big projects have already been handled. All of this, less than two miles from the shops, restaurants, and charm of Multnomah Village. Stylish, comfortable, and ready to enjoy from day one, this is one you’ll want to see!

Experience the perfect blend of modern comfort and charm in this beautifully updated mid-century ranch in SW Portland. Offering the ease and convenience of true main-level living, this thoughtfully remodeled home features an inviting open-concept floor plan designed for effortless everyday living and entertaining. At the heart of the home is the stunning remodeled kitchen, featuring an oversized quartz island, LG Signature gas range with double oven, Bosch dishwasher, LG refrigerator, pantry, and exceptional workspace. Vaulted ceilings, skylights, and expansive windows fill the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting ambiance throughout. A beautiful double-sided gas fireplace adds character while seamlessly connecting the main living areas. The spacious primary suite provides a private retreat with vaulted ceilings, a beautifully remodeled bathroom, and customized closets. Three additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests or a home office, complemented by an updated laundry space for added convenience. Step outside to enjoy the refinished deck surrounded by mature trees, creating a private and peaceful outdoor setting. Additional updates include newer flooring throughout, fresh exterior paint, updated lighting, and a newer roof.

Terrific two level home with primary bedroom on main floor with no steps from garage to main level. This charming home has been exceedingly well taken care of and most all systems as well as the living area are recently updated. Engineered hardwood floors across the main level, with a west facing formal living room with a two sided masonry fireplace which also opens to the dining room. The dining room has a sliding door which opens to a spacious covered deck. The updated kitchen with custom cabinets, quartz counters and stainless appliances including an induction cooktop sits off the side of the dining room. The main level also has three bedrooms, including the primary suite complete with full bath, plus another full bathroom on the same floor. The lower level has a lockable sliding door access to outside, one additional bedroom and a full kitchen and even its own electric meter! Lots of storage, along with new furnace 2026, central AC 2025, kitchen updated in 2007, main floor bath 2024, empire pacific windows 2007, R59 insulation 2025, main water line 2023, two electrical panels 2007, and much much more. All this close to Hillsdale, schools, and downtown Portland. Basement apartment is NOT a legal ADU.

Welcome to this exceptional Forest Heights home, just a one minute walk to the neighborhood park and commercial center. This beautifully updated four bedroom, three bathroom residence truly has it all.The remodeled kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring slab granite countertops, an oversized island, marble backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a custom breakfast nook. The stunning primary suite offers a newly renovated spa-like bathroom with a gorgeous glass tile shower. Enjoy surround sound in nearly every room, creating the perfect atmosphere for both everyday living and entertaining.French doors open to a spacious, fully fenced, level backyard, ideal for gatherings, pets, and play. Additional updates include new hardwood flooring, fresh interior paint, and a brand new deck completed in 2026.Located within the highly sought after Forest Park Elementary School boundary and surrounded by miles of scenic walking trails right outside your front door, this home offers the perfect balance of nature and convenience. Forest Heights is just minutes from Forest Park, Intel, Nike, and other major employers

listings.remarks: Reminiscent of a classic European carriage house, this charming Portland Heights/Goose Hollow residence pairs timeless character with thoughtful updates and inviting indoor-outdoor living. Warm hardwood floors, classic moulding, wainscoting, vintage-inspired lighting, and period details add distinctive personality.The main level features a gracious living room with wood-burning fireplace, elegant dining room with built-ins, and updated kitchen with space for casual dining. A bright, south-facing sun porch offers a versatile retreat for a home office, reading room, or morning coffee. Upstairs are three generous bedrooms and a beautifully remodeled full bath. The finished, walk-out basement adds a fourth bedroom, full bath, and bonus room with brand-new carpet—ideal for guests, recreation, media, or work-from-home space.Recent improvements include a newer French drain, updated plumbing and wiring, and fresh interior paint, adding peace of mind and a refreshed feel throughout.Outdoor living includes a newer flagstone side patio, covered back porch, and charming gazebo. The fully fenced property is ideal for pets and children. Tucked on a quiet dead-end street just blocks from NW 23rd, Zupans, Washington Park, and the best of Northwest Portland, this special home offers the perfect blend of neighborhood tranquility and urban convenience, with access to highly rated schools. Pre-inspected and ready to go!Open Saturday 12-2

Escape to your own private retreat with this stunning Northwest contemporary home, perfectly situated in a gorgeous park-like setting. From the moment you step inside, you'll feel the seamless connection between nature and modern elegance. Featuring vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light, the home offers a tranquil ambiance. The thoughtfully updated kitchen boasts a large island, solid surface countertops, stainless steel appliances and a skylight, opening to a cozy family room with custom built-ins and a gas fireplace. Sliding doors lead to a newly refreshed, expansive deck (resurfaced in 2025) overlooking lush landscaping and peaceful green space. The primary suite, conveniently located on the main level, features an updated ensuite bath with a luxurious walk-in shower and heated floors. A remodeled guest bathroom and additional generous living spaces round out this immaculate main level. The amazing lower level guest suite offers an en-suite, large walk-in closet and access to the outdoor space. Mature trees, vibrant landscaping, and multiple outdoor decks create a serene environment ideal for summer breezes and year-round relaxation. This home seamlessly blends natural beauty with modern comforts - don’t miss the chance to make it yours! Brand NEW HVAC Aug. 2026

Welcome to Broadmoor's Historic Farmhouse. Timeless excellence restored and reimagined. Poised atop the gentle slope of the manicured .23-acre lot, the vision of the home takes you back in time. The covered front porch invites you to take a seat, slow down and gaze across the lawn. Each finish in this home was carefully curated and is elegantly showcased by sunlight. Original and reclaimed Red Oak and Douglas Fir floors have been preserved on each level. Walking through the home you will encounter wainscoting, hidden built-ins, comprehensive millwork and no lack of character. A 2024 redesign focused on the kitchen installing new quartz counters and high end Smeg and Fisher & Paykel appliances. Sophisticated craftsmanship is showcased in each of the remodeled bathrooms. Upstairs the primary suite truly is a retreat. With the dual wardrobes, a Fleurco soaking tub, and heated marble floors, the ensuite bath leaves nothing to be desired. Two other spacious bedrooms can be found on the second level. Each light fixture, each doorknob, each cabinet pull, and every touch point was handpicked to create an immersive experience. The home has been extensively updated over the past 10 years including a 2015 re-pipe, 2015/2019 foundation rejuvenation, a 2019 re-wire, a 2019/2023 re-roof, 2023 Pella architectural windows and much more. Well over $300k has been invested to elevate the home. Beyond the cosmetics there are modern conveniences like the Nest thermostat, heated tile floors, and central AC. Offering an unmatched location near Raleigh Park, adjacent to Jesuit High School and close by New Seasons and the latest La Provence. Calling this property "Home" you can enjoy the harmony of the past and the present, every day.

A lovely classic English cottage welcomes you in the sought-after neighborhood of Hillsdale and Terwilliger. Sitting on a beautiful level lot backing to an open greenspace, this 1928 home preserves its original and timeless charm with modern updates and today’s comfort. Ideal floor plan to meet your everyday carefree and convenient living style. Inviting dining and living area is a perfect place for family and friends to gather for cheers. A cozy breakfast nook awaits to be enjoyed in the morning with a fresh cup of coffee. Handsome den with the fireplace is where you can sit for hours reading your favorite book. Generous sized rooms to create space for your hobbies, arts/crafts, or flex area for yoga/exercise. Surrounded with year round greenery and landscape, the yard and deck are a perfect place for fun and relaxation. Ideal location to trails, eateries, library, and more. Come and love living here at 1035 SW Westwood Drive!

listings.address: 14655 NW WEST UNION RD Portland, OR 97229
listings.remarks: Nestled on a beautifully landscaped 0.57-acre lot in the highly sought-after Bethany area, this exceptional 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers 2,990 square feet of versatile living space, incredible natural light, and endless possibilities. A long, private driveway welcomes you to this stunning property surrounded by mature trees, established gardens, and picturesque outdoor spaces. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, and rich wood flooring create a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout the main level. The spacious kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, built-ins, a central island with eat bar, and generous workspace. The adjoining dining room opens to an impressive 36' x 15' covered balcony complete with skylights and overlooking the private backyard oasis below. The main level also includes a light-filled living room with fireplace, a spacious primary suite with full bath, and two additional bedrooms. Downstairs offers exceptional flexibility with a spectacular 30' x 26' sunroom featuring a fireplace, a 12' x 12' bonus room, three additional bedrooms, laundry area, and sliding doors leading directly to the backyard. Outside, the expansive grounds have been thoughtfully landscaped to create a peaceful retreat ideal for gardening, recreation, entertaining, or simply enjoying the privacy and beauty of the setting. A tool shed provides additional storage and functionality. New Roof 2024. Adding even more value, the property is zoned R6, offering potential opportunities for additional development, lot division, or future investment possibilities. Buyer to perform all due diligence regarding zoning and development potential. This is a rare opportunity to own a private, park-like property with room to grow in one of Bethany's most desirable locations.

Rare opportunity to own a private, garden-enclosed retreat in desirable Multnomah Village! This 2,052 square foot home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a finished basement, and a detached garage. The property is surrounded by a beautiful garden and sits on an incredible 0.82-acre lot that shares a border with the local neighborhood park. Offering a unique blend of sprawling acreage, personal sanctuary, and long-term land potential, this home feels a world away while staying just minutes from the heart of the bustling village.

Private Retreat in the Heart of Multnomah Village! Nestled on 0.93 secluded, wooded acres, this one-of-a-kind property offers the perfect blend of privacy, natural beauty, and convenience. Enjoy a picturesque setting with sweeping territorial views from a wall of windows and an expansive wraparound deck; ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Unwind in the private jacuzzi or enjoy the charming treehouse tucked among the trees. Inside, the dramatic vaulted ceilings and stunning 20-foot floor-to-ceiling rock fireplace create a warm, inviting centerpiece. The versatile lower level features a private office with a separate entrance, plus a fourth bedroom or bonus room to fit your lifestyle. Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, or those needing extra space will love the insulated, heated 4-car garage with a large workshop and an unfinished second floor offering endless possibilities for a studio, home gym, storage, or future expansion. Experience the peace and tranquility of a private woodland retreat, just minutes from the shops, restaurants, parks, and amenities of desirable Multnomah Village.

HUGE PRICE REDUCTION & A MOTIVATED SELLER. Exceptional opportunity to own this truly unique custom-built home, perfectly situated in a peaceful, quiet neighborhood with convenient access to shopping, dining, schools, and major commuter routes. Welcoming antique entry doors set the tone for the character and craftsmanship found throughout this remarkable property.The main residence offers 4 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, complemented by a separate 1-bedroom, 1-bath ADU with its own private entrance—ideal for multigenerational living, guests, rental income, or a home office. Set on a beautifully landscaped 0.35-acre park-like lot, the outdoor spaces are designed for relaxation and enjoyment, featuring a tranquil water feature, hot tub, meandering pathways, storage sheds, RV hookup, and an expansive paver driveway with room for multiple cars. The main-level primary suite is a rare retreat, featuring dual walk-in closets and two private bathrooms. The inviting living room showcases a newer wood stove and flows seamlessly into the spacious dining area. A bright, sun-filled kitchen offers modern amenities, abundant workspace, and excellent functionality for everyday living and entertaining with stunning territorial views from multiple rooms and decks. An additional bedroom and full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and an expansive bonus room with its own private deck. This versatile bonus room could easily be converted into a second primary suite with a full bath and walk-in closet. The detached ADU includes a living room, kitchenette, bedroom, full bathroom, and separate entrance, providing outstanding flexibility and value. A rare combination of privacy, character, views, and versatility, this one-of-a-kind property is ready to welcome you home.

Tucked along the western edge of Washington Park, this hidden gem offers a rare opportunity to own a private retreat in one of Portland’s most remarkable settings. Nestled into 1.31 forested acres just off Burnside, the property feels worlds away while remaining only minutes from Pittock Mansion, downtown Portland, Hoyt Arboretum, the Oregon Zoo, the Rose Garden, and more. Imagine having your own peaceful forest sanctuary, surrounded by native plants and wildlife, just moments from one of the country’s most beloved public parks.Lovingly owned and maintained by the same owner for more than 25 years, the home offers 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and over 3,400 square feet of living space. Though enveloped by nature, the interior is filled with natural light thanks to an abundance of skylights and solar tubes, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout.The family room features hardwood floors, a striking stone fireplace, and French doors that open to an expansive back patio with an in-ground pool, pond, and additional water features. The spacious primary suite includes a beautiful walk-in shower, soaking tub, and heated floors. Designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles, the home offers generous living spaces throughout. In the kitchen, stainless steel appliances are complemented by skylights, a stunning hardwood eating bar, granite countertops, and a built-in wine rack.

PRICE IMPROVEMENT! Tucked within the coveted Ash Creek Woods neighborhood, this well-cared for residence with enormous ADU potential fuses classic architectural lines with clean modern updates to mirror its natural Pacific Northwest surroundings. A soaring foyer lit by an overhead skylight opens onto hardwood flooring that carries into a remodeled main living room anchored by a gas fireplace and hand-tiled hearth. The dining room feeds directly into an updated kitchen outfitted with crisp quartz counters, a deep basin sink, stainless appliances, and a central island with a built-in gas range and bar seating. The kitchen flows into a breakfast nook and an adjacent vaulted lounge area, forming a unified great room. Further along the main floor sits a generous office/den lined with built-in shelving, an updated powder room, and a full laundry room. Upstairs, the layout includes three bedrooms, dominated by a roomy primary retreat under pitched ceilings with an en-suite bath complete with soaking tub, dual vanity, walk-in closet, and separate shower enclosure. A hallway laundry chute drops down to the main floor, while two neighboring bedrooms each contain dedicated vanity sinks and a shared full bath. Downstairs, the high-ceiling daylight basement includes two sliding glass exits, adaptable living areas, a wet bar, fourth bedroom, full bathroom, dedicated sauna, and direct interior stairs to the garage — making this lower tier an ideal candidate for an ADU, extended family, or guest quarters. Exterior living spans two distinct outdoor decks: a newly renovated upper deck off the main level and expansive lower deck constructed from durable Trex material.
